title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: if only by imputation, evil's community not from serpent; tip
pass_a_gloss: So if Adam's actual deed is shared only because God charges it to all, and original vice sticks in us only as the penalty of that charged deed, then the sharing of the ill does not come from the serpent; nor is loss of original rightness and inherited corruption the serpent's breath on us, but—Placeus almost cannot say it—God's own effect and work. Tip before the death-as-devil reply / Psalm 32.
pass_b_english: If therefore actual sin is not common to all except by imputation—because God imputes it to all—and original sin or inhering vice is not in us except because it is fixed in us by God as the penalty of that imputed actual, the community of evil is not from the serpent. Nor is that privation of original justice and hereditary corruption the serpent's virus which he breathed upon us, but (which my mind shudders to say) God's effect and work.
source_text: Si igitur peccatum actuale non est omnibus commune, nisi imputatione; quia Deus illud omnibus imputat, nec est in nobis peccatum originale seu vitium inhaerens, nisi quia nobis in poenam actualis illius imputati a Deo infigitur, mali communitas non est a serpente; Nec ista privatio justitiae originalis & corruptio haereditaria virus est serpentis, quod nobis afflavit, sed (quod horret animus meus dicere) Dei effectum & opus.

choices.choice: If only by imputation, community not from serpent but God's work; tip
